mailwoman:sources.citation: Undang-Undang Nomor 14, 15 and 16 Tahun 2022 formed the provinces of Papua Selatan, Papua Tengah and Papua Pegunungan from Papua, and Undang-Undang Nomor 29 Tahun 2022 formed Papua Barat Daya from Papua Barat. ISO 3166-2:ID lists the four provinces.

The union of the Who's On First county records Sorong Selatan (102072635), Sorong (102072725), Maybrat (1108796861), Raja Ampat (1108796863), Tambrauw (1108796865). Each member is assigned to the province that GeoNames files most of the populated places inside its boundary under, counted on 2026-11-26. The assignment agrees with the regencies each statute lists.
